
# Pull Request

## Description

Describe the changes introduced by this pull request and the problem they address.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] New evidence collector
- [ ] Security improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test improvement
- [ ] Other

## Related issue

Link any related issue using `Closes #issue_number` or `Related to #issue_number`.

## Testing

- [ ] Added or updated tests where appropriate.
- [ ] Ran the test suite successfully.
- [ ] Ran `git diff --check`.
- [ ] Updated documentation where necessary.

Test command:

```bash
PYTHONPATH="$PWD:$PWD/src" pytest
```

## Security and evidence considerations

- [ ] No private keys, credentials, personal information, or sensitive device evidence are included.
- [ ] Original evidence is preserved without modification.
- [ ] Changes do not introduce unauthorized destructive device operations.
- [ ] Audit conclusions remain supported by the available evidence.

## Additional notes

Include compatibility considerations, limitations, or other relevant information.
